mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_ticket_history(ticket_id, operator_id, action, from_status, to_status, remark) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{operatorId}, #{action}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.ticket_id, h.operator_id, operator.real_name AS operator_name, h.action, h.from_status, h.to_status, h.remark, h.created_at FROM sys_ticket_history h LEFT JOIN sys_user operator ON operator.id = h.operator_id WHERE h.ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY h.created_at, h.id
